claims.claim: Senator Wellington Fagundes said the Liberal Party is expected to free its Senate bench on the vote to end the 6x1 schedule, while campaign coordination prefers abstention.
claims.episode_span: The Liberal Party is expected to release its senators on the constitutional amendment
claims.source_title: Escala 6x1: PL deve liberar bancada em votação; entenda estratégia
claims.supporting_quote: O PL, partido do candidato Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência, deve liberar a bancada na votação da proposta de emenda à Constituição (PEC) do fim da escala 6x1, segundo o senador Wellington Fagundes (PL-MT), líder do bloco de oposição da Casa.

claims.claim: The amendment would replace six days of work and one day off with five days of work and two of rest, and weekly hours would fall from 44 to 42 sixty days after enactment and to 40 a year later.
claims.episode_span: cutting weekly hours from 44 to 42 sixty days after enactment and to 40 a year later
claims.source_title: Escala 6x1: PL deve liberar bancada em votação; entenda estratégia
claims.supporting_quote: Pela proposta, a PEC entra em vigor 60 dias após a promulgação, quando a jornada cai de 44 horas semanas para 42 horas e um ano depois, para 40 horas.

claims.claim: Each Senate round on the amendment needs 49 of 81 votes, and the government wants both rounds before October 25.
claims.episode_span: Each round needs 49 of the Senate’s 81 votes.
claims.source_title: Escala 6x1: PL deve liberar bancada em votação; entenda estratégia
claims.supporting_quote: Em cada votação são necessários 49 dos 81 votos (três quintos).

claims.claim: Alejandro Sánchez said Uruguay’s government will send Parliament a bill allowing retirement at 60 with 30 years of work.
claims.episode_span: Presidency secretary Alejandro Sánchez said Monday after a cabinet meeting
claims.source_title: Gobierno uruguayo propone habilitar la edad de jubilación a los 60 años: a quiénes beneficiaría
claims.supporting_quote: El gobierno de Yamandú Orsi enviará al Parlamento un proyecto de ley para habilitar una causal de retiro anticipado a los 60 años y 30 años de trabajo , según anunció el secretario de Presidencia, Alejandro Sánchez , este lunes tras una reunión del gabinete.

claims.claim: Infobae reports the proposal is designed so the 30 percent of workers with the lowest wages can retire on amounts similar to or higher than those before the 2023 reform.
claims.episode_span: the 30 percent on the lowest wages
claims.source_title: Gobierno uruguayo propone habilitar la edad de jubilación a los 60 años: a quiénes beneficiaría
claims.supporting_quote: La iniciativa exige 30 años de trabajo y prevé que el 30% de los trabajadores con salarios más bajos pueda acceder a haberes similares o superiores a los que regían antes de la reforma de 2023
